searchText: I think the minimum possible value of the base fee is a function of the target gas. Is it what we want or we want an absolute minimum value independent on the target gas ? Min value is defined in the spec I believe? We discussed it previously, I think it is 0 and the function to lower the base fee ensures that base fee always can increase by at least one. ```py max(parent_base_fee * gas_delta // parent_gas_target // BASE_FEE_MAX_CHANGE_DENOMINATOR, 1) ``` Ok, so i may have an issue in the implementation. Because the minimum with 20M target is 7 wei. And with a very high value it was 1gwei. I will check I'm curious what you find! There should be no maximum either. <@!301186049323958275> to be clear i was not talking about the min base fee delta. But the minimum value the base fee can reach assuming empty blocks on a fixed target gas usage You should be able to reach `0` base fee I believe. but on the decrease size there is not the `max` call ```py parent_base_fee * gas_delta // parent_gas_target // BASE_FEE_MAX_CHANGE_DENOMINATOR ``` so yes the delta can be 0 but then parent base fee minus 0 = parent base fee Ah, I see. Because `7 // 8 == 0` I'm fine with that personally. ok sounds good How urgent do you think that is relative to shipping 1559 "v1"? My feeling is we're getting to the spot where the risk of tweaking the spec will be the main driver of delays, so we should probably keep things as close to what we have now (modulo small things like adding 2718 support, _maybe_ having a better update rule given it doesn't change much of the spec, etc.), get it on mainnet, and we can update the mechanism in a future hard fork once we have real-world data. <@!420951281910284289> can you share the standalone Filecoin talk here as well when it's up on Youtube 😄 ? will do juan benet was very encouraging that we get it on mainnet 🙂 https://twitter.com/juanbenet/status/1337516081750048769?s=20 Thanks!
